bind_address.description: IP address the milter should bind to. Prefer localhost (127.0.0.1) for local Postfix integration.

bind_port.description: Port number for the milter service. Must match MTA's milter configuration.

dns_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for DNS resolution before timing out. Lower values improve latency but may miss slow responses.

spf_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for full SPF evaluation. Must be ≥ dns_timeout × max_dns_lookups.

max_dns_lookups.description: Maximum number of DNS lookups allowed per SPF check (per RFC 7208). Setting to 0 disables the limit.

reject_permerror.description: Reject mail when the SPF record is malformed or invalid (permerror). Enable to block misconfigured senders.

reject_fail.description: Reject mail when SPF evaluation yields 'fail'. Recommended for spam prevention.

reject_softfail.description: Reject mail for 'softfail' results. Typically false to warn rather than reject.

reject_neutral.description: Reject mail for 'neutral' results. Usually false — neutral is not a rejection signal.

reject_none.description: Reject mail when no SPF record exists. May cause false positives; enable only if strictly required.

log_file.description: Optional path to a dedicated log file (e.g., /var/log/spf-milter.log). If empty, syslog is used.

trusted_ips.description: List of IP addresses or CIDR ranges that bypass SPF checks (e.g., trusted internal mail servers).

items.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address or subnet in CIDR notation.

exempted_domains.description: List of domains (exact match, no wildcards) exempted from SPF evaluation (e.g., internal domains).

local_nets.description: Additional private or internal IP ranges to treat as 'local' for sender verification.

passthrough_headers.description: List of additional email headers to pass through to downstream filters (e.g., X-Forwarded-For for geolocation).

add_auth_results.description: Whether to add an Authentication-Results header per RFC 5451 for SPF results.

auth_results_id.description: Identifier used in the Authentication-Results header (e.g., 'pyspf' or 'milter.pyspf').

skip_for_authenticated.description: Skip SPF checks for clients that have successfully authenticated (e.g., via SASL).

skip_for_localhost.description: Skip SPF checks for connections from localhost (127.0.0.0/8 and ::1).

fallback_policy.description: Policy to apply when no SPF record exists or parsing fails. 'neutral' is RFC-compliant default.
